Second public beta of Silence Splitter.

### Added

- Windows installer now bundles ffmpeg and ffprobe; no separate media tools install is required.

### Changed

- GitHub releases publish clear English notes from `.github/release-notes/` instead of auto-generated summaries.

### Known limitations

- Windows 10 and 11 only.
- Unsigned installer: SmartScreen may show a warning.
- MP4 input only.
- Installer size increased because ffmpeg is bundled.

See [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md) for the full details.
